ChenEyeOfTheTiger.name: Eye of the Tiger
ChenEyeOfTheTiger.description: Basic Attacks against Brew-soaked enemy Heroes deal 40% more damage and heal Chen for 40% of the damage done.

ChenFreshestIngredients.name: Freshest Ingredients
ChenFreshestIngredients.description: Increase the healing duration of Regeneration Globes by 150%. Quest: Gather 15 Regeneration Globes. Reward: Reduce Fortifying Brew's cooldown by 2 seconds, and 50% of its Shield persists indefinitely after drinking.

ChenStormstoutSecretRecipe.name: Stormstout Secret Recipe
ChenStormstoutSecretRecipe.description: Chen heals for 3.5% of his maximum Health when his Basic Abilities hit an enemy Hero.

ChenDeadlyStrike.name: Deadly Strike
ChenDeadlyStrike.description: Flying Kick no longer costs Brew. Additionally, its damage is increased by 125% while Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew.

ChenAccumulatingFlame.name: Accumulating Flame
ChenAccumulatingFlame.description: Increase Ignited damage by 20%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes who are Ignited increase its duration by 0.75 seconds.

ChenWitheringFlames.name: Withering Flames
ChenWitheringFlames.description: Igniting an enemy Hero reduces their Spell Power by 60% for 4 seconds.

ChenGiftOfTheOxStagger.name: Gift of the Ox
ChenGiftOfTheOxStagger.description: Increase the duration of Stagger's damage prevention by 1.5 seconds, and reduce the amount of damage taken over time to 50% of damage taken.

ChenBrewmastersBalance.name: Brewmaster's Balance
ChenBrewmastersBalance.description: While at or below 50 Brew, gain 20% Movement Speed. While at or above 50 Brew, regenerate an additional 18 (+4% per level) Health per second.

ChenElusiveBrawler.name: Elusive Brawler
ChenElusiveBrawler.description: Activate to gain 30% Movement Speed and Evade enemy Basic Attacks for 2 seconds. Chen's Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 2 seconds.

ChenHeroicAbilityWanderingKeg.name: Wandering Keg
ChenHeroicAbilityWanderingKeg.description: Roll around inside an Unstoppable barrel with 70% increased Movement Speed and 25 Armor, dealing 59 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the way and knocking them back. Lasts for 5 seconds.

ChenHeroicAbilityStormEarthFire.name: Storm, Earth, Fire
ChenHeroicAbilityStormEarthFire.description: After 1 second, Chen splits into three elemental spirits for 12 seconds, each with 70% of Chen's maximum Health and a unique Ability. The last spirit Ability that is cast is empowered. If all three spirits are killed, Chen will die as well. Storm can grant the spirits a Shield. E

ChenPressurePoint.name: Pressure Point
ChenPressurePoint.description: Flying Kick Slows the target enemy by 40% for 1 second, or by 80% if Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew.

ChenMasteryKegSmashATouchOfHoney.name: A Touch of Honey
ChenMasteryKegSmashATouchOfHoney.description: Increase the Slows from Keg Smash by 20% and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

ChenRingofFire.name: Ring of Fire
ChenRingofFire.description: After Igniting an enemy, become bathed in a fiery aura, dealing 55 (+4% per level) damage every second to nearby enemies for 5 seconds.

ChenMasteryFortifyingBrewEnoughToShare.name: Enough to Share
ChenMasteryFortifyingBrewEnoughToShare.description: Fortifying Brew instantly grants Chen a Shield that absorbs 180 (+4% per level) damage, and each second grants nearby allied Heroes a Shield that absorbs 140 (+4% per level) damage, up to 420 (+4% per level).

ChenFlyingLeap.name: Flying Leap
ChenFlyingLeap.description: Increase Flying Kick's range by 15% and reduce its cooldown by 0.5 seconds each time an enemy Hero takes damage from being Ignited.

ChenCelerity.name: Celerity
ChenCelerity.description: Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Stagger by 2 seconds and grant Chen 30 Armor for 3 seconds.

ChenComboStrikes.name: Combo Strikes
ChenComboStrikes.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same target deals 75% bonus damage. While Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew and for 2 seconds after, he gains 35% Attack Speed.

ChenMasteryWanderingKegUntappedPotential.name: Untapped Potential
ChenMasteryWanderingKegUntappedPotential.description: Increase Wandering Keg's Movement Speed bonus from 70% to 125%, and its Armor bonus to 75 for its duration and 3 seconds afterwards.

ChenElementalConduit.name: Elemental Conduit
ChenElementalConduit.description: Increase the spirits' Health to 100% of Chen's maximum Health and all of their Abilities are empowered.

ChenPurifyingBrew.name: Purifying Brew
ChenPurifyingBrew.description: Casting Fortifying Brew grants Chen Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

ChenEnergizingBrew.name: Energizing Brew
ChenEnergizingBrew.description: If Chen Channels Fortifying Brew for its full duration, then he gains 20% bonus Health and 20% bonus damage for 25 seconds.
